Constraint for LogisticsInteractionExtension, HasLogisticsInteraction and LogisticsInteraction:
If logistics interaction with an Orchestration Layer shall be supported, these elements must be added.
Note: LogisticsInteractionExtension must be annotated as SupportedRoleClass and HasLogisticsInteraction must be annotated as RoleRequirement.
